instruction: Send this document directly to my team via email using Writer's built-in email client integration.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in email client integration that allows sending documents directly via email from within the application. While users can send documents as email attachments through external email clients, Writer itself does not provide a native email sending feature.
